versions.note: Launch weights for multi-season player projections: this season's games before the week at full weight plus last season's at x0.1 (the best of 0 to 1 on 2021-22, before the evaluation seasons were looked at). Sample-trust constants, simulator spread and injury absorption are the values the 2025-only model used (fit_k.json, fit_cal.json, absorb.json); those were tuned on 2025 weeks, so the review's comparisons on 2025 favour keeping them.
